reading.rule: Use multi-clause sentences selectively and require evidence for inference, summary and explanation tasks.

vocabulary.rule: Use context and familiar word parts to support richer academic vocabulary; avoid unsupported specialist terminology.

number.rule: Use whole numbers through 100,000 for core number sense, with operations and estimation chosen for conceptual rather than speed-only practice.
